_comment: CATPIKKOPHIC-STOP calibration. CatStopATRMult>0 turns on the always-on backstop (PurchasePrice - CatStopATRMult×EntryATR) AND anchors risk-based position sizing, so run with -risk-pct 1 to size positions off the stop. Includes 0 so the grid can also confirm whether running without a catastrophic stop wins. go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker PIKK -strategy reversion -interval Hour1 -calibrate data/params/pikk/reversion_cal_catstop.json -out ./reports/PIKK_catstop -months 12 -train-months 6 -test-months 3 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20 -risk-pct 1
